# vergeio_tenant_clone (Action)

Copy a VergeOS tenant. name is the new tenant's name. no_vnet, no_storage, and no_nodes skip the network, the storage, and the nodes. When a flag is omitted, that part is copied. VergeOS accepts the clone before that copy finishes, so a new tenant can still list the source node. When no_nodes or no_storage is true, this action waits until those rows are gone and removes any the copy left behind. The copy is not stored in Terraform state. Import it with vergeio_tenant when you want Terraform to manage it. Invoke this action with `terraform apply -invoke`, or from a resource `lifecycle` `action_trigger`. Requires Terraform 1.14 or later. OpenTofu does not implement actions, and no resource behavior depends on this action.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Copy a tenant into a new name. The copy is not Terraform state.
# no_vnet, no_storage, and no_nodes skip those parts. Omit a flag to copy it.
# terraform apply -invoke=action.vergeio_tenant_clone.sandbox runs it on its own.
# Requires Terraform 1.14. OpenTofu does not implement actions.

resource "vergeio_tenant" "template" {
  name                = "customer-template"
  description         = "Tenant used as a clone source"
  password_wo         = "change-me"
  password_wo_version = 1
  powerstate          = false
}

action "vergeio_tenant_clone" "sandbox" {
  config {
    tenant_id  = vergeio_tenant.template.id
    name       = "sandbox-a"
    no_vnet    = false
    no_storage = false
    no_nodes   = false
  }
}
```

<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the new tenant. VergeOS rejects a name that is already in use.
- `tenant_id` (String) Tenant id, the same value as vergeio_tenant.id.

### Optional

- `no_nodes` (Boolean) Skip copying tenant nodes. When omitted, nodes are copied.
- `no_storage` (Boolean) Skip copying tenant storage. When omitted, storage is copied.
- `no_vnet` (Boolean) Skip copying the tenant network. When omitted, the network is copied.
